assumptions: Base URL host pattern was not stated in the source, so a tenant account host is assumed and needs confirmation.
Authentication method was not described in the source, so a bearer token option is assumed and needs confirmation.
Response body schema for GET /api/v2/users was not included, so it is assumed the response is a list and record field names are unknown except for name.
User fields such as email, status, role, type, last active and created dates were not documented, so only name is mapped and the rest are left empty.
It could not be confirmed whether disabled, suspended or dropped users are included in the list.
Pagination with fromName and showLimit is inferred from parameter descriptions; the exact cursor behavior and page size limit were not stated.
No per-user last activity field or audit/activity REST endpoint was documented in the source, so usage is marked unavailable. Account Usage views are SQL views, not REST endpoints.
Rate limits, error format, required privileges/scopes, and plan requirements were not stated in the source.
